_description: Help-doctor false-positive allowlist. Each entry maps a lib/commands/<file>.js to subs/flags that the detector flags as 'missing in help' but are intentionally documented elsewhere or are internal aliases.
_rules: If a flag is documented in bin/badi.js top-level help (Init/Update Options sections), allowlist it here.
If a subcommand is an internal alias (not for users), allowlist with a clear comment.
If you add a NEW flag to a command, add it to the command's --help text — do NOT just allowlist.

init.js._why: init flags are documented in bin/badi.js's top-level --help 'Init Options' section.

update.js._why: update flags are documented in bin/badi.js's top-level --help 'Update Options' section.

doctor.js._why: doctor.js's own --help falls back to the top-level menu; the flags appear in bin/badi.js (Init/Update/Doctor Options sections).

list.js._why: list.js --help falls back to the top-level menu; the flags appear in bin/badi.js.

stats.js._why: --sessions is the plural alias of --session; --session is already documented in help.

market.js._why: the 'full' subcommand is an alias form; it is the same as the default behavior (badi market <appId> == badi market full <appId>).
